description: This file defines the 'Filter' class, a controller component within the OpenCart admin extension modules, responsible for handling the filtering module's administrative functions such as displaying the configuration page and saving settings.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Filter module settings in the OpenCart admin panel, extending the core Controller and defining index and save actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the filter module configuration page, loads language, sets the page title, builds breadcrumbs, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the filter module settings via POST request; checks permissions, saves data, and returns a JSON response.
